trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring at the distal tip of the right fluke lobe.
